title: TopstepX™ — Commissions and Fees
content:
TopstepX™ — Commissions & Fees
These fees apply when trading the Trading Combine, Express Funded Account, and Live Funded Account. Commissions and fees are automatically deducted from each trade, and you'll see a breakdown in the TopstepX platform and from your Dashboard!
​
​ Round-Turn (RT) cost: charged when you complete both sides of a trade. Each side (Buy or Sell) incurs half the total, also called a "per side" fee.
Round-Turn Cost Breakdown:
Exchange Fee
| NFA Regulatory Fee
| Commissions
Exchange fees are set by the exchange and do not include the regulatory fee. Each varies by product.
| $0.02 round turn ($0.01 per side)
| Minis $1.00 round turn ($0.50 per side)
Micros $.50 round turn ($0.25 per side)

The CME is raising Exchange transaction fees on 2 products. Fees apply per side, so a round turn counts both entry and exit.
MCL: $0.50 to $0.60 per side ($1.20 round turn)
MNG: $0.60 to $0.70 per side ($1.40 round turn)
That's $0.10 more per side. Deducted automatically and shown in your trade activity.
